eas_text: A civil authority has issued A MISSING AND ENDANGERED PERSON ALERT for the following counties or areas: Jackson; Pipestone; Lincoln; Rock; Lyon; Nobles; Redwood; Cottonwood; Murray, MN; at 5:39 PM on JUL 27, 2026 Effective until 5:39 PM JUL 28, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: MISSING PERSON 82-year-old White male missing near 675 161st St., near Lake Wilson, MN. Last seen wearing a black long-sleeve shirt and blue jeans. If you have information, contact Murray County Sheriff's Office immediately 507-836-6168. If a male fitting this description is seen please report to the Murray County Sheriffs office. 507-836-6168
